messages:
mira: Heads-up — getting reports that Token Cost dashboard shows $0 or NaN for a handful of EU-prod orgs. Started ~08:15 UTC. Example org: org_8421. Screenshot: https://redwood.screens/abc123 :eyes:
rob: Thanks, looking. Any repro steps? Is this only dashboard or also raw billing ledger?
mira: Dashboard only so far, support UI shows tokens present but cost column is blank/NaN.
eli: Did we deploy anything to billing aggregator last night?
rob: We rolled billing-aggregator v2 at 02:40 UTC (deploy-bot below). It changes the join key from org_id -> billing_key. Suspect a join mismatch.
jen: Can you paste a sample query to reproduce? I'll tail the aggregator logs for 08:10–08:20 window.
mira: Quick minimal repro: open Console > Billing > Token cost, filter region=eu, date=2026-03-16. Several orgs show $0 / NaN in per-day column.
rob: Minimal SQL I ran locally to emulate dashboard aggregation:
```sql
SELECT be.org_id, sum(be.tokens) AS tokens, sum(be.cost_usd) AS cost
FROM billing_events_beam be
LEFT JOIN orgs o ON o.billing_key = be.billing_key
WHERE be.region = 'eu' AND be.day = '2026-03-16'
GROUP BY be.org_id;
```
rob: If orgs missing billing_key (migration in jan) the LEFT JOIN will produce NULL cost and dashboard post-process ends up with NaN.
eli: That matches an investigation note — a subset of EU enterprise orgs were converted to org_id primary and billing_key was deprecated but not backfilled in the events table.
jen: I'm pulling aggregator logs now. If we confirm join mismatch, do we want a hotfix to backfill billing_key in events or change the aggregator to fallback to org_id?
marco: Product-side: customers are seeing $0 cost which triggers billing alarms. We need a short-term patch and a communication plan.
rob: Short-term fix: change aggregator to prefer be.org_id when be.billing_key IS NULL, and then run a backfill job to populate billing_key for missing rows. Patch is small, I can PR.
jen: Can you attach the deploy hash and ETA? I'll reserve a 10m window to watch.
rob: PR ready, small change + unit test. ETA for staged deploy 30m.
deploy-bot: deploy started billing-aggregator v2.1 @ 2026-03-16T09:05:12Z (hash: a7c4f9d) to staging.
mira: Support: will inform affected customers as 'investigating' and escalate if SLA alarms fire.
eli: I'll prepare a billing-safe script to recompute missing cost rows after fix. Need a list of affected orgs; rob can dump from query above.
rob: Dumped list -> 6 orgs in EU. Pushed to #incidents/ops link: https://redwood.ops/dumps/8421-list.txt
jen: Logged incident INC-2026-87, assigned to eng-billing. Monitoring alert created for token-cost NaN spikes.
marco: Thanks — once staged run looks good, plan for prod deploy in 2h and backfill overnight. Communication draft: short apology + ETA + confirmation when costs recomputed.
mira: Copy that. I'll update the customer's ticket with the incident link and ETA.
eli: Follow-up: need postmortem doc with root cause = partial migration + missing backfill; action items: backfill run + safer join fallback + add unit test to aggregator.
rob: Agreed. I'll include migration check in deploy checklist.
jen: I'll keep an eye on logs and rollback if error rate spikes.
mira: Thanks team :pray: — marking thread resolved once prod backfill completes.
